premise: Raccoon counts; Ladybug hides under Mushroom's cap, but Bear cub is too big to hide anywhere, so he closes his eyes — if he can't see them… — falls asleep, and his snore gives him away.
inspiration: The folk hide-and-seek game where the biggest can't hide, turned: being found is the fun, and the sleepiest player wins the best nap.
lesson: Being found is part of the fun.

en-US.title: Bear Cub Plays Hide-and-Seek
en-US.text: {raccoon:enter} Raccoon had a game. [excited] Hide-and-seek! I'll count! {raccoon:live hold} He covered his eyes. One… two… three… Quick as anything, {ladybug:enter} Ladybug spotted {mushroom:enter} Mushroom and {ladybug:go under mushroom} crept under her red cap. {mushroom:face happy} [giggles] That tickles! But {bear:enter} Bear cub was too big to hide. {bear:face sad} Not behind Mushroom. Not under a leaf. {bear:wobble} Then he had an idea. If I close my eyes, nobody can see me! {bear:live hold} He closed his eyes… and nodded off. {sfx:snore} Zzz… zzz… Eight, nine, TEN! {raccoon:live resume} Ready or not! {raccoon:face happy} Raccoon listened. Zzz… zzz… {raccoon:go to bear} [laughs] Found you! {bear:live resume} Bear cub woke with a start. {bear:face surprised} How did you know? You were snoring! {mushroom:live} Mushroom giggled so much that… ah… ah… {sfx:achoo} ACHOO! {ladybug:go back} Out crawled Ladybug. {all:face happy} {all:hop} Found you too! Now YOU count, Bear cub. One… two… {bear:live hold} three… [whispers] zzz. {ladybug:hearts} So everyone hid, and Bear cub had the best nap of all.

es-ES.title: Osito juega al escondite
es-ES.text: {raccoon:enter} Mapache tenía un juego. [excited] ¡Al escondite! ¡Yo cuento! {raccoon:live hold} Se tapó los ojos. Uno… dos… tres… Rapidísima, {ladybug:enter} Mariquita vio a {mushroom:enter} Seta y {ladybug:go under mushroom} se metió bajo su sombrero rojo. {mushroom:face happy} [giggles] ¡Qué cosquillas! Pero {bear:enter} Osito era demasiado grande para esconderse. {bear:face sad} Detrás de Seta, no. Debajo de una hoja, tampoco. {bear:wobble} Entonces tuvo una idea. ¡Si cierro los ojos, nadie me ve! {bear:live hold} Cerró los ojos… y se quedó dormido. {sfx:snore} Zzz… zzz… ¡Ocho, nueve, DIEZ! {raccoon:live resume} ¡Allá voy! {raccoon:face happy} Mapache escuchó. Zzz… zzz… {raccoon:go to bear} [laughs] ¡Te pillé! {bear:live resume} Osito se despertó con un respingo. {bear:face surprised} ¿Cómo lo has sabido? ¡Estabas roncando! {mushroom:live} Seta se rió tanto que… aaa… aaa… {sfx:achoo} ¡ACHÍS! {ladybug:go back} Y salió Mariquita, riéndose. {all:face happy} {all:hop} ¡A ti también te pillé! Ahora cuentas TÚ, Osito. Uno… dos… {bear:live hold} tres… [whispers] zzz. {ladybug:hearts} Así que todos se escondieron, y Osito se echó la mejor siesta del mundo.

snore.prompt: a bear cub snoring softly and slowly, cute and cosy

achoo.prompt: a tiny, cute comic sneeze, achoo, with a soft sparkly twinkle after it, playful
